chapters.title: Chapter 1: In Peach Garden, three brothers' oath is sworn; 'Gainst Yellow Turbans, merit first is borne.
Chapter 2: Zhang Fei in fury whips the Postal Knave; Royal Uncle He plots the eunuchs' grave.
Chapter 3: Dong Zhuo, in Wenming's hall, Ding Yuan berates; Li Su, with gold and pearl, Lü Bu persuades.
Chapter 4: The Prince of Chenliu crown'd as Han's lord; His strike undone, Cao Cao presents the sword.
Chapter 5: At Cao's forg'd decree, lords arise to fight; Three heroes break the pass, 'gainst Lü Bu's might.
